source.expression: mix(mandelbrot(x * scale - 0.62 + t * motion * 0.12, y * scale + u * motion * 0.12), julia(x * scale * (1.15 + phase * 0.55), y * scale * (1.15 + phase * 0.55), -0.72 + t * motion * 0.24, 0.27 + u * motion * 0.24), phase)

layers.name: Looped fractal morph
layers.expression: mix(mandelbrot(x * scale - 0.62 + t * motion * 0.12, y * scale + u * motion * 0.12), julia(x * scale * (1.15 + phase * 0.55), y * scale * (1.15 + phase * 0.55), -0.72 + t * motion * 0.24, 0.27 + u * motion * 0.24), phase)

layers.name: Camera contour pulse
layers.expression: 0.5 + 0.5 * sin((mandelbrot(x * scale - 0.62, y * scale) + julia(x * scale, y * scale, -0.72, 0.27)) * 32 + phase * tau)
